definition_zh: 主要的；最重要的；主管道；总线路；市电；大海
definition_en: most important or largest; a principal pipe or cable for water, gas or electricity; the public power supply; the open sea
core_image: 一张地图上，最粗的那条路通向城市中心
scene: 暴雪过后的清晨，维修车沿着城外最宽的那条公路往城里开。The main road into the valley was still blocked by snow.
sceneCN: 这里指最重要、最主要的那条（第 1 个义项：主要的）；句意为通往山谷的主路仍被雪堵住。

pos.zh: 主管道；总线路；市电；大海

derivatives.zh: 由 main 加 -ly 构成，义为「主要地；大部分地」
由 main 与 land 复合，义为「大陆；本土」
由 main 与 stream 复合，义为「主流」
由 main 与 stay 复合，义为「支柱；主要依靠」

senses.title: Most important or largest
senses.definition: being the most important, largest or most influential of its kind
senses.definitionCN: 在同类别中最重要、最大或最有影响力的
senses.example: The main reason for the delay was the weather.
senses.exampleCN: 延误的主要原因是天气。
senses.why: Old English mægen meant strength, so what is main is what carries the greatest weight in a situation.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 mægen 意为力量，因此 main 指在某个局面里分量最重的那一个。

senses.title: A principal pipe or cable
senses.definition: the largest pipe or cable that carries water, gas or electricity to many places
senses.definitionCN: 把水、燃气或电输送到许多地方的最大管道或线路
senses.example: A burst water main flooded the lower street.
senses.exampleCN: 一根爆裂的自来水主管淹没了地势较低的那条街。
senses.why: The adjective naming the chief thing became a noun for the chief channel, because that pipe carries the greatest volume and serves the whole network.
senses.whyCN: 形容「主要之物」的形容词转成名词，指最主要的输送通道，因为那根管道输送量最大、服务整个网络。

senses.title: The open sea
senses.definition: the open ocean, especially when seen as a great expanse away from land
senses.definitionCN: 开阔的海洋，尤指远离陆地、显得辽阔无边的海面
senses.example: The ship sailed out into the main at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 船在黎明时驶向外海。
senses.why: The old sense of main as great or mighty survived at sea, where the open ocean is the great expanse beyond the shore.
senses.whyCN: main 古义「宏大、强大」在海上留存下来：岸边之外那一片开阔水域就是宏大的存在。

senses.title: The public electricity supply
senses.definition: the ordinary electricity supply provided to homes and buildings, especially in British usage
senses.definitionCN: 供给住宅和建筑的常规电力，尤见于英式用法
senses.example: The lamp can run on batteries or on the mains.
senses.exampleCN: 这盏灯可以用电池，也可以接市电。
senses.why: British speakers call the shared public supply the mains because it is the central source every building draws from, like the main pipe of a water system.
senses.whyCN: 英式说法把公共供电称作 the mains，因为它是每栋建筑都从中取电的中心来源，就像供水系统里的主管道。

intro.en: Main comes from a Germanic noun for strength; the adjective for the strongest or chief thing later became a noun for the chief channel.
intro.cn: main 来自日耳曼语中表示力量的名词；表示最强、首要之物的形容词后来转成指主要通道的名词。

items.en: The adjective comes from mægen, a noun meaning power, strength or force.
items.cn: 这个形容词来自 mægen，一个意为力量、力气、威力的名词。

items.en: The reconstructed base *maginam carried the same idea of strength and ability, and it also lies behind might and may.
items.cn: 重构词根 *maginam 同样表示力量与能力，might 与 may 也出自这里。

items.en: Middle English main kept the sense of chief or principal, and the word began to describe the leading road, pipe or clause.
items.cn: 中古英语 main 保留「首要、主要」的意思，并开始用来描述最主要的道路、管道或从句。

items.en: The noun main narrowed to the principal channel of a water or gas system, while the sea sense remained poetic.
items.cn: 名词 main 缩小为供水或燃气系统的主管道，而「大海」义仍带诗意。

items.en: Modern British usage adds the mains for public electricity, and 「main road」, 「main idea」 and 「main clause」 fix the adjective in daily speech.
items.cn: 现代英式用法又用 the mains 指公共供电，「main road」「main idea」「main clause」则把形容词固定在日常表达里。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on main or on its Germanic root; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives for what ranks first.
note.cn: 形近组收由 main 或其日耳曼词根构成的词；近义组收表示排在最前的形容词。

entries.definition: Chiefly, or for the most part.
entries.definitionCN: 主要地；大部分地。

entries.definition: The principal land mass, as opposed to islands.
entries.definitionCN: 相对于岛屿而言的主要陆地；大陆。

entries.definition: The ideas or practices accepted by most people.
entries.definitionCN: 被多数人接受的思想或做法；主流。

entries.definition: The person or thing that provides the chief support.
entries.definitionCN: 提供主要支撑的人或事物；支柱。

entries.definition: Most important; the leader of a group.
entries.definitionCN: 最重要的；团体负责人。

entries.definition: First in importance; the head of a school.
entries.definitionCN: 最重要的；学校校长。

entries.definition: Most important or most successful.
entries.definitionCN: 最重要或最成功的；领先的。

entries.definition: First in order or importance.
entries.definitionCN: 在顺序或重要性上居首的。

normalIntro.en: The word starts from strength, becomes an adjective for what weighs most, and then a noun for the biggest pipe or supply.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词从力量出发，先成为指「分量最重」的形容词，再成为指最大管道或供应的名词。

normal.en: Main comes from mægen, strength, so the main thing is the one with the most force behind it.
normal.cn: main 来自 mægen（力量），所以最主要的东西就是背后力量最大的那一个。

normal.en: The same root gives might and may, which still carry the idea of power and possibility.
normal.cn: 同一词根还给出 might 与 may，它们仍带着力量与可能性的意思。

normal.en: A water main is simply the main pipe, the adjective turned into a noun by dropping the word it described.
normal.cn: water main 就是「主要的管道」，形容词通过省去所修饰的词而变成名词。

normal.en: The mains in British homes is the shared public supply, the central channel that every socket draws from.
normal.cn: 英国家庭说的 the mains 是公共供电，是每个插座都从中取电的中心线路。

normal.en: Main clause and main idea show the adjective doing the same job in grammar and in thought: picking out what carries the weight.
normal.cn: main clause 与 main idea 表明这个形容词在语法和思想里做同一件事：挑出承载重量的部分。

abstract.en: The thickest road on a map is not always the longest, but it is the one the whole region depends on.
abstract.cn: 地图上最粗的那条路未必最长，却是整个地区依赖的那一条。

abstract.en: A single pipe under the street feeds every tap in the block; that hidden centrality is the word's quiet image.
abstract.cn: 街道下的一根管道养活整片街区的每个水龙头；这种看不见的中心性正是这个词安静的意象。

abstract.en: To call something main is to make a judgment about weight, not about size alone.
abstract.cn: 把某物称作 main，是在判断它的分量，而不只是判断它的体积。

examples.en: The main road into the valley was still blocked by snow.
examples.cn: 通往山谷的主路仍被雪堵住。

examples.en: A burst water main flooded the lower street.
examples.cn: 一根爆裂的自来水主管淹没了地势较低的那条街。

examples.en: The ship sailed out into the main at dawn.
examples.cn: 船在黎明时驶向外海。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「门」——进城的大门那条路最重要；记住 main 是主要的、主路。

root: 古英语 mægen（力量）经中古英语 main（首要的）而来；同族词 might、may 也出自表示「力量、能力」的日耳曼词根，无可靠拉丁同族。

sensesIntro.en: The core sense is greatest weight; from it come the principal channel, the public supply, and the old poetic sense of the open sea.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心义是分量最重；主要通道、公共供电，以及「大海」的古老诗意都由它分出。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the thickest road on a map, with every side road branching off it.
core.cn: 核心意象：地图上最粗的那条路，所有岔路都从它分出去。

branches.en: the widest road on a hand-drawn map
branches.cn: 手绘地图上最宽的那条路

branches.en: a buried pipe feeding every tap on the street
branches.cn: 埋在地下、供养整条街水龙头的管道

branches.en: a ship alone on a wide grey sea
branches.cn: 一艘船独自在灰色辽阔的海面上

branches.en: a lamp switched from battery to wall current
branches.cn: 一盏灯从电池切换到墙上的电流

branches.en: one adjective becoming a noun for the chief channel
branches.cn: 同一个形容词变成指主要通道的名词

intro.en: The word is held together by an Old English noun of strength, its adjective use, and English compounds that extend the idea of the chief part.
intro.cn: 这个词由古英语表示力量的名词、它的形容词用法，以及延伸「主要部分」之意的英语复合词共同支撑。

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin cognate is recorded for this word; its relatives are Germanic, such as might and may.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有可靠的拉丁同族词记录，它的近亲属于日耳曼语，例如 might 与 may。

definition_zh: 主要地；首要地；大部分地；大体上
definition_en: chiefly, above all; for the most part
core_image: 一屋子的人里，绝大多数都举着同一种颜色的旗子
scene: 散场后，清洁工推着车穿过空荡的展厅，地上留下的东西并不多。The mess left behind was mainly paper cups and torn programmes.
sceneCN: 这里表示「大部分是」（第 2 个义项：大部分地）；句意为留下的垃圾主要是纸杯和撕破的节目单。

pos.zh: 主要地；首要地；大部分地

derivatives.zh: mainly 去掉副词后缀 -ly 得到的形容词与名词，义为「主要的；主管道」
由 main 与 stream 复合，义为「主流」
由 main 与 stay 复合，义为「支柱」

senses.title: Above all; chiefly
senses.definition: more than anything else, when the point is what matters most
senses.definitionCN: 在强调最重要的原因或因素时，表示「首要地、主要地」
senses.example: The delay was mainly caused by the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 延误主要是风暴造成的。
senses.why: Main means chief, and -ly turns that judgement into an adverb: mainly marks the factor that outweighs the rest.
senses.whyCN: main 意为首要的，-ly 把这个判断变成副词：mainly 标出压过其余因素的那一个。

senses.title: For the most part
senses.definition: in most cases or to most of a group, when the point is quantity or proportion
senses.definitionCN: 在强调数量或比例时，表示「大部分、多数情况下」
senses.example: The audience was mainly students from nearby schools.
senses.exampleCN: 观众大部分是附近学校的学生。
senses.why: The same adverb can measure a group instead of ranking a cause, so mainly also means that most members share the trait being named.
senses.whyCN: 同一个副词也可以衡量一个群体，而不是给原因排序，所以 mainly 还表示多数成员都具有所说的特征。

intro.en: Mainly is the adjective main fitted with the old adverb suffix -ly, and main itself goes back to a Germanic noun for strength.
intro.cn: mainly 是形容词 main 加上古老的副词后缀 -ly 构成，而 main 本身可追溯到日耳曼语表示力量的名词。

items.en: The base is mægen, a noun for strength or force.
items.cn: 基础词是 mægen，一个表示力量或威力的名词。

items.en: The reconstructed *maginam is the common Germanic source of mægen and of might.
items.cn: 重构形式 *maginam 是 mægen 与 might 共同的日耳曼语来源。

items.en: Middle English main took the sense chief or principal from that root.
items.cn: 中古英语 main 从这一词根取得「首要、主要」的意思。

items.en: The adverb suffix -ly, from Old English -līce, was added to main to make mainly.
items.cn: 副词后缀 -ly 源自古英语 -līce，加在 main 后构成 mainly。

items.en: Modern English uses mainly for both the leading cause and the largest share of a group.
items.cn: 现代英语里 mainly 既指首要原因，也指群体中的最大部分。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms built on main; the near-meaning group gathers adverbs of majority and chief importance.
note.cn: 形近组收由 main 构成的形式；近义组收表示多数与首要地位的副词。

entries.definition: Chief or principal; also a principal pipe or supply.
entries.definitionCN: 首要的；也指主管道或公共供应。

entries.definition: The principal land mass, as opposed to islands.
entries.definitionCN: 相对于岛屿而言的主要陆地；大陆。

entries.definition: Ideas or practices accepted by most people.
entries.definitionCN: 被多数人接受的思想或做法；主流。

entries.definition: The chief support of a system or group.
entries.definitionCN: 系统或群体的主要支柱。

entries.definition: In most cases or to the greatest degree.
entries.definitionCN: 多数情况下；大部分地。

entries.definition: Above all; mainly.
entries.definitionCN: 首要地；主要地。

entries.definition: To a great extent; mostly.
entries.definitionCN: 在很大程度上；大部分。

entries.definition: Mainly; in the majority.
entries.definitionCN: 主要地；占多数地。

normalIntro.en: The adverb adds -ly to a word for strength and chief weight, so it can rank a cause or measure a majority.
normalIntro.cn: 这个副词把 -ly 加在表示力量与首要分量的词后，因此既能给原因排序，也能衡量多数。

normal.en: Mainly is main plus -ly, so the adverb keeps the idea of ranking: one thing outranks the rest.
normal.cn: mainly 是 main 加 -ly，所以这个副词保留了排序的意思：某样东西压过其余。

normal.en: The -ly ending comes from Old English -līce, which turned a quality into a manner of acting.
normal.cn: -ly 词尾来自古英语 -līce，把某种性质变成行事的方式。

normal.en: When mainly points at a cause, it works like chiefly; when it points at a crowd, it works like mostly.
normal.cn: 当 mainly 指向原因时，它相当于 chiefly；当它指向一群人时，它相当于 mostly。

normal.en: The word is a judgement about weight, so mainly does not mean only; other factors can still be present.
normal.cn: 这个词是对分量的判断，所以 mainly 不等于 only，其他因素仍可能存在。

normal.en: Mainly because and mainly due to are the two phrases that show the adverb ranking a reason.
normal.cn: mainly because 与 mainly due to 是展示这个副词给原因排序的两个短语。

abstract.en: A hall where nearly everyone holds the same colour of flag: the crowd shows what mainly means.
abstract.cn: 满厅几乎人人举着同一种颜色的旗子：人群本身就展示了 mainly 的意思。

abstract.en: To say what mainly caused something is to put one weight on the scale and let the others stay lighter.
abstract.cn: 说出某件事主要因何而起，就是在一杆秤上放一个更重的砝码，让其余都轻一些。

abstract.en: Ranking and proportion are two faces of one adverb, both asking which part deserves the emphasis.
abstract.cn: 排序与比例是同一个副词的两张脸，两者都在问哪一部分值得强调。

examples.en: The delay was mainly caused by the storm.
examples.cn: 延误主要是风暴造成的。

examples.en: The audience was mainly students from nearby schools.
examples.cn: 观众大部分是附近学校的学生。

examples.en: The mess left behind was mainly paper cups and torn programmes.
examples.cn: 留下的垃圾主要是纸杯和撕破的节目单。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「妹利」——主要靠小妹出力；记住 mainly 是主要地。

sensesIntro.en: The core sense is ranking by weight; it splits into the leading cause and the largest share of a group.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心义是按分量排序；义项分成首要原因与群体中的最大部分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a scale with one heavy weight tipping it down.
core.cn: 核心意象：一杆秤，一端放着最重的那块砝码。

branches.en: one heavy weight tipping the scale
branches.cn: 一块重砝码压得秤面倾斜

branches.en: a crowd where nearly every flag is the same colour
branches.cn: 几乎每面旗都是同一种颜色的人群

branches.en: ranking a cause and counting a majority under one adverb
branches.cn: 用一个副词既给原因排序，也数出多数

branches.en: a sentence naming the storm first

intro.en: The word is held together by the Germanic noun for strength, its adjective main, and the adverb suffix -ly.
intro.cn: 这个词由日耳曼语表示力量的名词、它的形容词 main，以及副词后缀 -ly 共同支撑。

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin cognate is recorded for this word; the family is Germanic, reaching back to a noun for strength.
